 # Quota Park Probe
 
-Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded probe count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).
+Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded park-tick count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).
 
-Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a one-line `quota-probe: <n>` marker comment that doubles as the durable counter for the next tick's cadence decision.
+Every tick records a lightweight `quota-park-tick: n` marker comment — the durable cadence clock — so the tick count advances even between probes (an attempts-only counter deadlocks after the first failed probe: probe #2 can never fire). Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a `quota-probe: <n>` marker used for probe numbering only. The probe command is logged redacted (sensitive header/credential values masked, env-var name references untouched).
 
 ## Parameters
 
 - `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
 - `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
-- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes.
+- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes. The command is logged in redacted form — inline credentials are masked.
 
 A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

- **BLOCKING (review thread 1) — probe cadence deadlock, confirmed and reproduced.** The shipped cadence was attempts-only: `probeDue(priorProbeCount, everyN)` fired only when the recorded probe count was a multiple of N, and the count (`countProbeMarkers`) advanced only when a probe fired. After failed probe #1 the count was stuck at 1 forever (`1 % 3 !== 0`), so probe #2 could never fire — the park never self-lifts (AC3 broken). Reproduced in RED first: a new integration test driving `quotaParkProbe.action` over 7 consecutive failing SM ticks (cadence 3) fired exactly **one** probe before the fix.
- **CI `crap` check failure (log not fetchable).** Reproduced locally with the pinned `IstiN/crap4js@83ee6201` + `nyc` instrumented run against an `origin/main` baseline: **2 regressions** (`developBugAndCreatePR.js::completeInterruptedPath` 8→12, `developBugAndCreatePR.js::action` 23.7→27.9) and **6 new functions over the CRAP-threshold 8** (`classifyFailure` 13, `quotaParkProbe.js::action` 24.8, `shouldSkipForQuotaPark` 9.2, `recoverMissingResponse` 9, `parkQuotaPath` 8.8, `parkQuotaExhaustedDevelopment` 8.6).
- **SUGGESTION (review thread 2) — probe command logged verbatim.** An operator override of `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` with an inline credential would land in SM job logs / CI artifacts.

## Approach

1. **Cadence fix (reviewer's option 1 — record every tick).** New durable per-tick clock: `quotaParkProbe.action` posts a lightweight `quota-park-tick: n` marker **every** SM tick, so the completed-tick count advances even between probes. `probeDue(completedTicks, everyN)` now fires when the completed tick count is a multiple of N — probes recur on ticks 1, N+1, 2N+1, … while the provider stays quota-blocked. `quota-probe: <n>` markers remain but drive probe *numbering* only. New pure functions in `js/common/quotaCircuitBreaker.js`: `tickMarkerLine`, `countTickMarkers`, shared `maxMarkerNumber`, plus `redactCommand`.
2. **CRAP ratchet fixes — decompose, no behavior change.** `classifyFailure` split into `hasQuotaEvidence`/`quotaEvidenceOf` (13→6); `shouldSkipForQuotaPark` into `labelsOf` (9.2→6); `quotaParkProbe.js::action` into `resolveInputs`/`readCommentBodies`/`recordTickMarker`/`runProbeCommand`/`handleProbeFailure`/`liftPark`/`removeLabelQuietly`/`moveToReadyQuietly` (24.8→6, helpers ≤7); `recoverMissingResponse` into `quotaContextOf`/`quotaParkGate` (9→7); `parkQuotaExhaustedDevelopment`/`parkQuotaPath` PR-labeling into `parkLabelOpenPr` (8.6→~5, 8.8→~5); bug-leg `completeInterruptedPath` partial-push + quota gate into `pushPreservedAnalysisWork`/`executePartialPushPlan`/`parkQuotaInterruptedGate` (12→1); bug-leg `action` ctx/classification into `quotaGateContextOf`/`quotaFailureClassificationOf` (27.9→≤23.7, back to/below main).
3. **Redacted probe logging (thread 2).** `quotaBreaker.redactCommand` masks sensitive header/credential values (`Authorization: Bearer sk-…`, `--api-key=…`) while leaving env-var name references (`$FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY`) and the safe default command untouched; `action` logs the redacted form.
4. Docs (`docs/agents/quota_park_probe.md` + regenerated `docs/agents/generated/quota_park_probe.md`) updated for the tick cadence and redaction.

## Files Modified

- `js/common/quotaCircuitBreaker.js` — tick-marker cadence clock, `redactCommand`, CRAP decomposition of `classifyFailure`/`shouldSkipForQuotaPark`/`countProbeMarkers`, updated doc comments.
- `js/quotaParkProbe.js` — tick-based cadence (records `quota-park-tick: n` every tick), redacted probe logging, decomposition into single-purpose helpers.
- `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` — `quotaContextOf`/`quotaParkGate` extraction from `recoverMissingResponse`; `parkLabelOpenPr` extraction from `parkQuotaExhaustedDevelopment`.
- `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js` — `pushPreservedAnalysisWork`/`executePartialPushPlan`/`parkQuotaInterruptedGate` extraction from `completeInterruptedPath`; `parkLabelOpenPr` extraction from `parkQuotaPath`; `quotaGateContextOf`/`quotaFailureClassificationOf` extraction from `action`.
- `js/unit-tests/test_quotaCircuitBreaker.js` — 23 → 28 tests: tick-marker counting, `redactCommand`, tick-cadence not-due/failure/unpark updates, the blocking **integration test (7 consecutive failing ticks ⇒ probes on ticks 1, 4, 7)**, self-lift after repeated failures with correct probe numbering, redacted-log assertion.
- `docs/agents/quota_park_probe.md`, `docs/agents/generated/quota_park_probe.md` — tick cadence + redaction documented.

Fixed — took option 1 (record every tick) exactly as suggested.

**Root cause confirmed**: the attempts-only counter could never advance past a failed probe, so probe #2 was unreachable. Reproduced first in RED with a new integration test driving `quotaParkProbe.action` over 7 consecutive failing SM ticks (cadence 3): exactly one probe fired before the fix.

**The fix** (`js/common/quotaCircuitBreaker.js` + `js/quotaParkProbe.js`):

- Every tick the probe handler now posts a lightweight `quota-park-tick: n` marker — the durable tick clock — so the completed-tick count advances even between probes.
- `probeDue(completedTicks, everyN)` fires when the completed tick count is a multiple of `everyN`; `quota-probe: <n>` markers remain for probe numbering only.
- Probes now recur on ticks 1, N+1, 2N+1, … while the provider stays quota-blocked, and the park self-lifts on the first successful probe (AC3).

**Integration test added** as requested: `cadence keeps firing while quota-blocked: 2×everyN+1 failing ticks → probes on ticks 1, N+1, 2N+1` runs the real `quotaParkProbe.action` for 7 consecutive failing ticks through the mocked tracker and asserts probes #2 and #3 actually fire, plus one tick marker per tick and correct probe numbering on the later self-lift test.

Suite: `run_quotaCircuitBreaker.json` now 28 passed, 0 failed; full suite 4626 passed, 0 failed. The CRAP-ratchet decomposition needed for the `crap` CI check is in the same pass (ratchet now reports 0 regressions / 0 new over threshold / 1 improvement).

Done — the probe command is now logged in redacted form.

- New pure helper `redactCommand(command)` in `js/common/quotaCircuitBreaker.js` masks sensitive values — `Authorization: Bearer sk-…`, `--api-key=…`, header-shaped `token:`/`secret:` values — while leaving env-var **name** references untouched, so the safe default command (which only references `$FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` etc.) logs unchanged.
- `js/quotaParkProbe.js` now logs `quotaBreaker.redactCommand(command)` instead of the raw command, so an operator override of `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` with an inline credential no longer lands in the SM job logs or CI artifacts.

Covered by two new tests: a `redactCommand` unit test (inline credential masked / env-var reference kept / default unchanged) and a probe-level test that captures the logs and asserts the raw credential never appears while `Running probe #1` still does. Full suite green (4626 passed, 0 failed).

{"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded park-tick count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Every tick records a lightweight `quota-park-tick: n` marker comment — the durable cadence clock — so the tick count advances even between probes (an attempts-only counter deadlocks after the first failed probe: probe #2 can never fire). Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a `quota-probe: <n>` marker used for probe numbering only. The probe command is logged redacted (sensitive header/credential values masked, env-var name references untouched).

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

After failed probe #1 the count was stuck at 1 forever (`1 % 3 !== 0`), so probe #2 could never fire — the park never self-lifts (AC3 broken). {"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded park-tick count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Every tick records a lightweight `quota-park-tick: n` marker comment — the durable cadence clock — so the tick count advances even between probes (an attempts-only counter deadlocks after the first failed probe: probe #2 can never fire). Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a `quota-probe: <n>` marker used for probe numbering only. The probe command is logged redacted (sensitive header/credential values masked, env-var name references untouched).

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes. The command is logged in redacted form — inline credentials are masked.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

After failed probe #1 the count was stuck at 1 forever (`1 % 3 !== 0`), so probe #2 could never fire — the park never self-lifts (AC3 broken). {"content":"# quota park probe

Bounded self-lift for the gh-1087 provider-quota park: runs locally on every SM tick against tickets carrying the park label (default `provider_quota`) and fires one cheap provider ping only when the recorded park-tick count hits the `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` cadence (default 3 ticks).

Every tick records a lightweight `quota-park-tick: n` marker comment — the durable cadence clock — so the tick count advances even between probes (an attempts-only counter deadlocks after the first failed probe: probe #2 can never fire). Probe success means the quota window has reset or the provider was reconfigured — the handler removes the park label, clears the development/rework dispatch trigger labels, moves the ticket back to Ready For Development and posts an un-park comment, so the normal dispatch lanes resume on the next tick. Probe failure keeps the park and posts a `quota-probe: <n>` marker used for probe numbering only. The probe command is logged redacted (sensitive header/credential values masked, env-var name references untouched).

## Parameters

- `jobParams.quotaParkLabel` — park label name to watch and remove (default `provider_quota`). When overridden, the SM rule's JQL (`labels = provider_quota`) must be overridden to match.
- `jobParams.quotaProbeEveryNTicks` — probe cadence in SM ticks (default 3). The first tick after the park always probes (a misclassification self-corrects immediately).
- `jobParams.quotaProbeCommand` — the cheap provider ping shell command (default: a 1-token chat completion against the fa provider config `FA_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` / `FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY` / `FA_PROVIDER_MODEL`; curl `--fail` keeps the park on any HTTP error). Override for non-fa provider shapes. The command is logged in redacted form — inline credentials are masked.

A human un-parks immediately by removing the park label from the ticket — the probe rule stops matching and no further probes fire.

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

- **BLOCKING (review thread 1) — probe cadence deadlock, confirmed and reproduced.** The shipped cadence was attempts-only: `probeDue(priorProbeCount, everyN)` fired only when the recorded probe count was a multiple of N, and the count (`countProbeMarkers`) advanced only when a probe fired. After failed probe #1 the count was stuck at 1 forever (`1 % 3 !== 0`), so probe #2 could never fire — the park never self-lifts (AC3 broken). Reproduced in RED first: a new integration test driving `quotaParkProbe.action` over 7 consecutive failing SM ticks (cadence 3) fired exactly **one** probe before the fix.
